meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing is the final human-required handoff because the maintainer raised npm security.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成版本号递增、构建校验、git 标签与发布说明生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发版都要手动改版本号、打标签、写发布说明。
copy.tagline_en: Automate version bumps, build checks, git tags, and changelog generation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if every release means manually editing versions, tagging, and writing release notes.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会判定版本号该升 PATCH、MINOR 还是 MAJOR，同步改写八个清单文件里的版本，然后跑构建、打 tag、建 GitHub release、重生成 CHANGELOG，npm 发布留给你手动做。
howto.when: 当你要给 Claude Code 插件发新版本、升版本号或走发布流程时接管；npm 发布之外的所有步骤都由它完成。

say.text: 把版本升到 0.8.1，这是个补丁修复
say.note: 它改八个清单文件的版本并跑构建

say.text: 帮我走一遍发布流程，到我手动 npm publish 为止
我 npm 发布完了，验证一下版本并跑 Discord 通知
say.note: 会先 npm view 核对再发通知

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude picks the bump level (PATCH/MINOR/MAJOR), rewrites the version in eight manifest files, runs the build, tags and pushes, creates a GitHub release, regenerates CHANGELOG.md, and leaves npm publish to the human.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you release a new version of a Claude Code plugin: it owns every step from version bump through GitHub release and changelog, stopping before the human-only npm publish.

say_en.note: Rewrites eight manifests and runs the build

say_en.text: Run the full release flow up to my manual npm publish
say_en.note: It finishes tag, GitHub release, changelog

say_en.text: I published to npm — verify the version and send the Discord notice
say_en.note: Checks npm view first, then notifies
